findings.description: Two detached modular houses, each roughly 2,000 square feet, 24 feet tall, with two bedrooms and a single-car garage, are proposed for the 0.12-acre vacant lot at 1531 Jerrold Avenue in Bayview, by developer Rore Modular Technologies with design by Roof and Realm.
